name: defectdojo
description: Official DefectDojo skills for Claude Code. Query, triage, import, and report on your DefectDojo Pro vulnerability data from the terminal. Requires DefectDojo Pro.

plugins.name: defectdojo
plugins.description: DefectDojo umbrella. One command installs the full official skill set: connection setup, finding queries and triage, scan import and CI wiring, and executive reporting. Requires DefectDojo Pro.

plugins.name: defectdojo-connect
plugins.description: Connect Claude Code to a DefectDojo Pro instance. Wires the built-in MCP server, stores API credentials once, provides the dd-api REST bridge used by every other DefectDojo skill, and diagnoses broken connections. Requires DefectDojo Pro.

plugins.name: defectdojo-triage
plugins.description: Ask questions about DefectDojo findings, products, and security posture in plain language, then work the triage queue: close, verify, mark false positive, risk accept, tag, and annotate findings with a confirmation step before any write. Requires DefectDojo Pro.

plugins.name: defectdojo-import
plugins.description: Import scanner output and SBOMs into DefectDojo Pro with automatic product and engagement creation, correct import versus reimport handling, and background-import polling. Also wires scan upload into CI pipelines. Requires DefectDojo Pro.

plugins.name: defectdojo-report
plugins.description: Produce executive, program, and remediation-trend security reports from DefectDojo Pro insights data, or generate a native DefectDojo report artifact for download. Requires DefectDojo Pro.
